The evaluator is in `main.odin`, and `build.sh` builds an optimized binary at `./app`. `node check.mjs` passes all 6 example cases.

I also checked edge cases by hand, and they all gave the expected output:
- `(-9223372036854775807 - 1) % -1` gives 0.
- These give `error`: the literal `9223372036854775808`, `-9223372036854775808` (its literal is out of range), and `(-9223372036854775807-1)/-1`.
- `-4611686018427387904*2` gives the minimum value, because unary minus binds tighter than `*`.
